reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime, changing device MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: MTU changes on network devices are now detected continuously without requiring agent restart; this improves operational flexibility but represents a change in runtime behavior.

proposed.statement: MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime; changing device MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU.
